name: k2_anime-real
prompt: Yoneyama Mai style, hatsune miku with long teal twin tails, dramatic rim light, strong silhouette, dynamic pose looking back over her shoulder, crisp contour lines, composited into a real photograph of a busy city street at sunset, photorealistic background, bokeh, 35mm photo, warm sunlight matching on both
note: 米山舞风的 Miku + 真实街景。米山舞 LoRA 默认 0.9 会把写实场景拉平成插画，这里压到 0.6，和 bold-inked 0.6 对半，既留住逆光轮廓和飘逸头发，又保住背景的照片感；实测 0.8 时招牌与建筑开始失真。提示词三段不能拆：Yoneyama Mai style 加角色、dramatic rim light 和 dynamic pose 给画风、real photograph / bokeh / 35mm 钉住背景，最后 sunlight matching on both 统一光照。换角色改第二段，后两段别动。
